name: natural_fading
description: Default. Walks back from the latest prompt: 2 verbatim turns, then 5 turn-summaries, then recent episodes of this session, then recent decisions, capped with a session-agnostic relevance sweep. Mimics how a person remembers a conversation — sharp at the top, fading into gist as it gets older — while surfacing relevant material from anywhere in the corpus via general_search.
